# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `zineps` MCP server pointing at Zineps' hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.zineps.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Zineps user login — no API key to configure.
- Logo: the Zineps icon from the `Zineps/cursor-plugin` GitHub repository, resized to 512×512.
